app.title: We've built an open-source feature flag server for 11 years
app.author: ivarconr
app.description: Open‑source feature‑flag service that manages flags, experiments, and user targeting.
proposed_tests: Docker‑compose bring up a single‑node Unleash instance.
Create a new flag via the REST API and verify its default state.
Send 10k toggle requests through the SDK and measure latency.
Run a health‑check endpoint and confirm 200 OK.
